why_this_run_exists: SELF-REPORTED DEFECT: when speeding up the build before running m=9, I moved the delta guard from the full k x n grid to a row-wise pivot+8-sample check WITHOUT flagging it. That left m=9/10/11 carrying a weaker delta than m=6/7/8 while the index asserted a single uniform standard. This run repairs the ladder through ONE implementation for all 13 rows, per pre_statement.md ADDENDUM 2 committed BEFORE the run.

method.route: EXACT Lagrange route. F is built as f_j = SUM_i Y[j,i] lam_i^{-1} L_i with L_i = Pi/(Z-a_i)/Pi'(a_i). Off-diagonal vanishing L_i(a_l) = 0 (l != i) is structural (the factor (Z-a_l) is retained and the division is exact). Hence lam_l f_j(a_l) = Y[j,l] for ALL (j,l) follows EXACTLY from the n scalar checks L_i(a_i) = 1.
method.cost: O(n D) per instance instead of O(k n D); exact, not Monte Carlo
method.load_bearing_degree_condition: max_j deg(f_j) <= D, machine-checked per instance, ABORT (not warn) on failure. This is the entire licence for the Lemma-2 degree argument: f and f + Pi agree at every support point yet differ (deg(f+Pi) = n), so without deg <= D the agreement-at-n-points reasoning collapses. Verified TRUE on all 13 instances; no instance aborted.
method.redundancy_checks: seeded off-diagonal probes (200/instance) and assembly spot-checks (3 rows/instance)

RESULT.note_m6_m7_m8_reproduced: the three m=6, two m=7 and two m=8 rows — which previously used the full k x n grid — REPRODUCE under the new route. No finding, no escalation needed.

EVIDENCE_LABELS_by_row.delta (lam_i F(a_i) = Y[:,i]): MACHINE-VERIFIED EXACT on all 13 instances, one code path
EVIDENCE_LABELS_by_row.alpha (Pi F' + Pi' F = G^2 F^(2)): MEASURED per instance on all 13 — NOT relabelled. This measurement is an INDEPENDENT CHECK ON APON LEMMA 3 ITSELF and is the evidence behind the headline phrase 'confirmed by measurement'. Deriving it from the cited lemma instead would silently turn 'Apon's mechanism confirmed by independent measurement' into 'our data is consistent with Apon's lemma', with no number moving.
EVIDENCE_LABELS_by_row.beta (Delta_{p,q} != 0): MEASURED per instance with the exhibited pair recorded
EVIDENCE_LABELS_by_row.m=12_policy_if_ever_run: alpha MAY be derived from exact delta + Apon Lemma 3 at m=12 if and only if measurement proves unaffordable there, and that row's alpha would then be labelled CITED-DEPENDENCY — a different KIND of evidence, not a different confidence level. In one sentence: at m <= 11 the mechanism is MEASURED; at m = 12 it would be INFERRED from a cited lemma given a measured delta. No m=12 row exists at this time.
